## Repository inclusion fixes

- Removed direct GitHub installation guidance and now documents installation through the official ioBroker repository.
- Standardized the custom administration interface on English until complete ioBroker i18n support is implemented.
- Added a safe polling interval range of 60 to 2,147,483 seconds to prevent Node.js timer overflow and unintended tight polling loops.
- Replaced deprecated directional power roles with `value.power.consumed` and `value.power.produced`.
- Removed inactive Modbus configuration fields that users could configure even though they had no runtime effect.
- Added regression tests covering the repository inclusion requirements and polling interval boundaries.

## Compatibility

- Existing SAX Power cloud credentials, battery model assignments, object IDs and measured values remain compatible.
- Previously stored inactive Modbus fields may remain in existing instance configurations, but they are no longer declared or used by the adapter.
- Full localization of the custom React administration interface is planned for a future feature release.

## Validation

- TypeScript tests and package validation passed.
- Backend lint and TypeScript compilation passed.
- Administration type-checking and production build passed.
- The generated npm package contents were verified with `npm publish --dry-run`.
- The release-fix build was installed locally and verified against the existing SAX Power instance before publication.
